clarifications.question: Are these real MADDPG/QMIX/MAPPO training implementations?
clarifications.answer: No. Source functions are centralized scripted assignment; this local concept adapter has no gradient, learned network or convergence claim.

clarifications.question: Does a negative coefficient prove an actual greedy failure?
clarifications.answer: No. It invalidates the sufficient sign certificate; an actual finite Cartesian value gap is reported separately.

clarifications.question: Can tied actions have different tuples?
clarifications.answer: Yes. The oracle criterion is equal best value, not action tuple equality.

clarifications.question: May the training CSV contain central state?
clarifications.answer: Yes. It is a separate declared training column, never an execution actor input.

clarifications.question: Are repeated Q references deduplicated?
clarifications.answer: No. They are separate algebraic path contributions; constants have no Q dependency.

clarifications.question: Does saving a rollout train a policy?
clarifications.answer: No. The scripted policy identity and observed actions are only durable evidence.

proof_limits: Finite local typed tests do not prove genuine MARL training, CTDE learned-policy quality, convergence or benchmark advantage
Source current framework/baseline and lecture timing/BFS claims are historical course data, not externally verified facts or test oracles
Sign certificates are sufficient and may reject actually monotone or constant instances; actual greedy gap requires enumerated values in the declared finite domain
Empty-grid Manhattan shortcut does not apply to obstacle worlds; local wall-clock margins depend on this machine and runtime, not a universal SLA
The60minute allocation has not been calibrated with humans
